versions.content: The function NvM_ReadRamBlockFromNvm shall get the ROM Block default values and copy them to application if • configuration ID check is enabled ( NvMDynamicConfiguration is set to TRUE ) AND • a configuration ID mismatch was detected AND • for the related NvBlock in the Application Software Cluster the NvMRe- sistantToChangedSw is set to FALSE AND • NvM Proxy is in NvM startup phase In all other cases the function NvM_ReadRamBlockFromNvm shall process the normal data copy functionality from NvM to application
